theorems.name: Submission.polyhedral_approx_restriction_tau
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = tauAction n M θ ξ ω) → ∀ (A : Set (Eucl P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsRestriction T A S → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, S ω = tauAction n (M ∩ A) θ ξ ω
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
